title: a16z Podcast: Writing a New Language of Storytelling with Virtual Reality

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Chris Milk calls virtual reality the “ultimate empathy machine.” The filmmaker and founder of VR shop Vrse talks with a16z’s Chris Dixon about how virtual reality can connect with people in ways no other medium can...
reader_summary.overview: Chris Milk calls virtual reality the “ultimate empathy machine.” The filmmaker and founder of VR shop Vrse talks with a16z’s Chris Dixon about how virtual reality can connect with people in ways no other medium can.. Milk describes the ways virtual reality production veers from the traditional techniques of filmmaking. The discussion happened as part of a16z’s 2015 Academic Roundtable.
